name: Disneyland Ronto Roasters Morning Wrap (Scrambled Eggs, Cheddar & Grilled Pork Sausage in Soft Pita)
brandOrRestaurant: Ronto Roasters (Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge · Disneyland Park)
whyItWorks: Warm pillowy pita bread wrapped around fluffy scrambled eggs, melted aged cheddar, and a grilled pork sausage link—one of the best handheld breakfasts in Disneyland when ordered without the peppercorn sauce.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Mobile-order the Ronto Morning Wrap and customize/ask at the counter for **"No Peppercorn Sauce"** so it is strictly eggs, cheddar, sausage, and warm pita.
watchOuts: Default build includes a tangy peppercorn sauce—always request "no peppercorn sauce"
